stem: This information helps the reader understand that the word persistence in paragraph 5 of the article “Sticking to It” means —
instruction: Read this information about the word persistence. from Latin per-, meaning “through,” and sistere, meaning “to stand firm”

options.label: A
options.text: continuing even with setbacks or difficulty

options.label: B
options.text: waiting for the right moment to act

options.label: C
options.text: continuing to improve even after succeeding

options.label: D
options.text: holding onto an opinion against the majority
